description: This Python source file defines a Keras callback class 'CocoEval' used for performing COCO evaluation metrics at the end of each training epoch during object detection model training. It imports TensorFlow Keras API and a COCO evaluation utility from a relative module. The class implements initialization and epoch-end logic to evaluate model performance and optionally logs metrics to TensorBoard.
